open_points.subject: record construction policy
open_points.text:
Constructing such a record here — its constructor, model_construct, model_validate,
or model_copy of a parameter of that type — is rejected (record_construction_bypassed).
open_points.other_text: Never assign to an attribute of a model value (models are frozen): derive a changed value with value.model_copy(update={...}) or construct a new instance.
open_points.question: Which rule governs the listed records: must revisions use only the imported builders, or may they use model_copy or direct construction?

open_points.subject: change_service_principal_status
open_points.text: - change_service_principal_status: [BEHAVIOR] MUST allow only a transition whose row of the imported PRINCIPAL_STATUS_TRANSITIONS constant, selected by from_status, the persisted current status, and to_status, the requested one, has allowed true; revoke every service credential of a principal it disables, and append the principal.disable member of = models.AuditAction or the principal.enable member of = models.AuditAction atomically.
open_points.rule:
Адрес называет значение, которое уже размещено,
и не размещает значения, записанного рядом прозой.
open_points.question: Replace the inline serialized values principal.disable and principal.enable with the corresponding enum member names PRINCIPAL_DISABLE and PRINCIPAL_ENABLE while retaining = models.AuditAction.

open_points.subject: change_service_principal_status
open_points.text: - change_service_principal_status: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append, through the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, a single audit built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, passing as action the transition it performed — the principal.disable member of = models.AuditAction or its principal.enable member — the SERVICE_PRINCIPAL member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the principal identifier as entity_id and None as project_id. A request for the status the principal already holds changes nothing and appends no audit.
open_points.rule:
Адрес называет значение, которое уже размещено,
и не размещает значения, записанного рядом прозой.
open_points.question: Replace the inline serialized values principal.disable and principal.enable with the corresponding enum member names PRINCIPAL_DISABLE and PRINCIPAL_ENABLE.

open_points.subject: create_service_principal
open_points.text: - create_service_principal: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST authorize access management, persist the closed source_type/scope_mode principal, and append the principal.create member of = models.AuditAction atomically.
open_points.rule:
Адрес называет значение, которое уже размещено,
и не размещает значения, записанного рядом прозой.
open_points.question: Replace the inline serialized value principal.create with the enum member name PRINCIPAL_CREATE.

open_points.subject: create_service_principal
open_points.text: - create_service_principal: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit through the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the principal.create member of = models.AuditAction as action, the SERVICE_PRINCIPAL member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the service_principal_id of the new principal as entity_id and None as project_id.
open_points.rule:
Адрес называет значение, которое уже размещено,
и не размещает значения, записанного рядом прозой.
open_points.question: Replace the inline serialized value principal.create with the enum member name PRINCIPAL_CREATE.

open_points.subject: grant_producer_project
open_points.text: - grant_producer_project: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST authorize access management, validate the same active Registry UUID with validate_project_reference before the transaction, reject an existing active pair, and append the producer_grant.create member of = models.AuditAction atomically.
open_points.rule:
Адрес называет значение, которое уже размещено,
и не размещает значения, записанного рядом прозой.
open_points.question: Replace the inline serialized value producer_grant.create with the enum member name PRODUCER_GRANT_CREATE.

open_points.subject: grant_producer_project
open_points.text: - grant_producer_project: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit through the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the producer_grant.create member of = models.AuditAction as action, the PRODUCER_GRANT member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the grant_id of the new grant as entity_id and the validated project_id as project_id.
open_points.rule:
Адрес называет значение, которое уже размещено,
и не размещает значения, записанного рядом прозой.
open_points.question: Replace the inline serialized value producer_grant.create with the enum member name PRODUCER_GRANT_CREATE.

open_points.subject: issue_service_credential
open_points.text: - issue_service_credential: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST allocate the next key_version, insert the built credential and append the principal.credential_issue member of = models.AuditAction atomically, and expose the plaintext exactly once, only in the returned ServiceCredentialIssue.
open_points.rule:
Адрес называет значение, которое уже размещено,
и не размещает значения, записанного рядом прозой.
open_points.question: Replace the inline serialized value principal.credential_issue with the enum member name PRINCIPAL_CREDENTIAL_ISSUE.

open_points.subject: issue_service_credential
open_points.text: - issue_service_credential: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit through the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, built with the imported build_service_credential_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the principal.credential_issue member of = models.AuditAction as action and the new credential.
open_points.rule:
Адрес называет значение, которое уже размещено,
и не размещает значения, записанного рядом прозой.
open_points.question: Replace the inline serialized value principal.credential_issue with the enum member name PRINCIPAL_CREDENTIAL_ISSUE.

open_points.subject: revoke_producer_project
open_points.text: - revoke_producer_project: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST revoke only the addressed active grant and append the producer_grant.revoke member of = models.AuditAction atomically.

open_points.question: Replace the inline serialized value producer_grant.revoke with the enum member name PRODUCER_GRANT_REVOKE.

open_points.text: - revoke_producer_project: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit through the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the producer_grant.revoke member of = models.AuditAction as action, the PRODUCER_GRANT member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the revoked grant_id as entity_id and the project_id of the revoked grant as project_id.

open_points.question: Replace the inline serialized value producer_grant.revoke with the enum member name PRODUCER_GRANT_REVOKE.
